nodes.label: language_model.model.embed_merge
nodes.op_formula: y = x;  y[b, p_n] = v[b, n]   (p_n: n-th placeholder of x[b])
nodes.op_description: Overwrite the placeholder rows of x with the rows of v (HF `masked_scatter`). Zero FLOPs; bytes read x, read v, write y. Layout: B and D of v must match x's placement (and closure); when x's sequence is cut over a world W, v's N axis is co-sharded in the same world as a padded Block, N_rank = ceil(N/W), reached from a replicated v by a local slice with no communication. This is a uniform-density co-shard projection: it assumes the placeholder rows spread evenly over the sequence blocks, not an ownership a mask proves. Any other placement is refused.

nodes.label: language_model.model.output_attn_res
nodes.op_formula: softmax_i((rms(v_i) ⊙ norm_w ⊙ proj_w)·1) · v,  v = cat(history, prefix)
nodes.op_description: Kimi-K3 `_apply_attn_res` (modeling_kimi_linear.py:1075-1088): a softmax-weighted combination of the history and the running prefix. Inputs: prefix [B,S,D], history [B,S,m,D], and the scoring weights — the `*_res_norm` gain [D] and the `*_res_proj` row [1,D] — which only score; they gate nothing. Their tensors are the parameter nodes wired in; the op owns none.
